title: Kanban Agent Evolution implementation task graph

nodes.title: Canonical types: state machines, profiles, commands, dependency semantics
nodes.description:
Define types for task lifecycle, attempt lifecycle, review lifecycle, evidence lifecycle, board profiles (legacy/mirror/orchestrated), KanbanCommandContext, KanbanTaskAttempt, KanbanVerificationRun, KanbanReviewDecision, KanbanAttemptBaseline, KanbanOutboxEntry, and the canonical edge direction dependency→dependent with explicit satisfaction policy.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- All type, enum, and interface definitions from the SDD model section are present in one canonical module.
- dependency→dependent is the only supported edge direction in new code.
- completed, explicitly skipped, and explicitly waived statuses satisfy dependency readiness; failed does not unless continueOnFailure is explicit.
- BoardProfile type resolves as legacy for untyped boards.
- Attempt creates its own epoch and lease independent of task fields.
- VerificationRun has contentId, attemptId, attemptEpoch, taskRevision, and policyVersion.
- ReviewDecision references attemptId and verificationRunIds, not a snapshot of task state.
- Generic task/board patches cannot mutate evidence, reviews, lifecycle, or attempt identity.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes on affected packages.
- Domain unit tests for transition validation, edge/policy checks.

nodes.title: Cross-surface conformance fixture harness
nodes.description:
Build a table-driven conformance harness that runs the same valid and invalid command sequences through manager API, kanban tool, Director queue adapter, and WebUI dispatch adapter (once profiles exist).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Fixtures cover legal state transitions, illegal transitions, stale revision/epoch/lease rejections, duplicate command idempotency, unmet dependencies, full WIP, and board profile rules.
- Every fixture records expected output shape, error codes, and zero-storage-side-effect assertions for failures.
- Fixtures are independent of persistence backend.
- Legacy-untouched, mirror, and orchestrated profiles each have representative fixture sets.

**Verification:**
- Focused harness bootstrap tests.
- Existing legacy manager tests remain green after adding fixtures.

nodes.title: Independent P0 contract acceptance gate
nodes.description:
Independent reviewer approves the canonical model, profile definitions, dependency policy, and conformance fixture set.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- State machines, dependency direction/policy, board profiles, and immutable-field authority are reviewed and accepted.
- Conformance fixtures exist and can be executed against each active surface.
- Fixtures demonstrate current behavioral drift before repairs.
- No production code is changed.

**Verification:**
- Reviewer report attached.
- Fixture execution log attached.

nodes.title: Command context, command service, and legacy adapter shell
nodes.description:
Implement the KanbanCommandContext type, command id structure, and a command service that validates preconditions, enforces immutable-field rules, and delegates to the existing manager API or new attempt/lifecycle mutations based on board profile.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- CommandContext carries commandId, actorId, reason, expectedBoardRevision, expectedAttemptId/Epoch/LeaseId.
- Command service rejects state changes that would mutate lifecycle, review, verification, or attempt fields through non-canonical adapters on orchestrated boards.
- Legacy profile skips immutable-field gates and preserves current behavior.
- Mirror profile permits source-owned field mutations and rejects autonomous lifecycle transitions.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Command service unit tests for each profile's allowed and rejected mutations.

nodes.title: Managed ReserveAttempt and StartAttempt for orchestrated boards
nodes.description:
Implement ReserveAttempt (creates attempt identity, epoch, lease in Todo without lifecycle stage change) and StartAttempt (validates reservation epoch/lease, records running attempt, atomically advances Todo→Running on managed boards).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Reserve succeeds only when task is ready, dependencies met, WIP/policy/capacity permits, and current lease/epoch absent.
- Concurrent reserves produce exactly one owner; the rest receive a conflict.
- Start validates matching epoch, lease, dependency readiness, and board revision.
- Running transition writes lifecycle history, attempt record, and task/column projection atomically on file backend.
- Legacy boards keep existing claim+assignment flow; orchestrated boards refuse legacy claim.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Unit tests for concurrent reserve, start with stale epoch/lease, start after task revision change.
- Conformance harness runs managed start path.

nodes.title: Mandatory fencing for all worker-owned mutations
nodes.description:
Add attempt epoch + lease validation to heartbeat, progress, scope update, submit, fail, release, and cancel. Block generic filesystem tool writes from stale contexts.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Every worker-owned mutation requires matching attemptId, epoch, and leaseId.
- Missing or mismatched fields produce a structured error; legacy boards fall back to unfenced behavior with telemetry.
- kanban-boundary runtime blocks fs-write/shell tools when lease context no longer matches.
- Stale worker cannot overwrite successor ownership, result, or evidence.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Unit tests for each fenced mutation with stale and current tokens.
- Runtime boundary test with context lease mismatch.

nodes.title: Lifecycle-safe expiry, release, and recovery
nodes.description:
Implement ExpireAttempt, ReleaseAttempt, and retry/fail recovery using canonical commands that respect lifecycle history and attempt epochs.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Expired queued attempt returns task to Todo or fails per policy, recording lifecycle history.
- Expired running attempt invalidates epoch before another attempt can reserve.
- Release clears active attempt and returns task to ready/blocked per lifecycle rules.
- Recovery increments epoch for expired leases; retry creates a new attempt with fresh epoch.
- Repeated recovery command is idempotent.
- Recovery never advances a task to Review or Done.
- Existing recoverStaleTaskAssignments adapter checks profile and delegates to canonical path for orchestrated boards.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Recovery race, lease fence recovery, idempotency tests.
- Managed projection unchanged after normal recovery.

nodes.title: Shared dispatch adapter for Director and WebUI
nodes.description:
Extract a common dispatch service for readiness, reserve, start, renewal, release, and terminal handling that Director and WebUI both call. WebUI removes its independent fixed-lease dispatch and calls the shared service instead.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Director kanban_queue and WebUI dispatch both call the same reserve/start/renew functions.
- Same effective lease TTL and heartbeat calculation applies to both paths.
- Host-side renewal is active for both awaited and fire-and-forget execution.
- WebUI dispatch has no independent lease algorithm after cutover.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Conformance harness runs dispatch scenarios through both Director and WebUI adapters.

nodes.title: Independent P1 managed execution acceptance gate
nodes.description:
Verifies that orchestrated boards are fully executable via reserve/start, stale recovery is lifecycle-safe, fencing prevents stale-owner mutations, and both dispatch paths converge.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Orchestrated happy path: ReserveAttempt → StartAttempt → SubmitAttempt → RequestReview produces authoritative lifecycle history.
- Concurrent reserve tests produce exactly one owner.
- Stale worker fencing blocks writes and heartbeat.
- Recovery without projection drift after expired lease.
- Director kanban_queue and WebUI dispatch produce identical attempt state for the same task.
- Independent security/reliability review reports no Critical/High finding.

**Verification:**
- All conformance fixtures in P1 scope pass for every applicable surface.
- Projection-repair is not called during any normal orchestrated execution in the test suite.
- Reviewer report attached.

nodes.title: Attempt-bound verification baseline and report binding
nodes.description:
Capture base commit, tree hash, task revision, criteria hash, expected-files hash, and worktree identity at attempt start. Persist verification reports with attemptId, epoch, revision, and policyVersion. Implement or remove snapshot/persist options. Report never accepted when attempt, epoch, revision, criteria hash, or baseline does not match.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- StartAttempt records baseline fields atomically.
- Verification uses stored baseline; unrelated pre-existing changes are distinguishable.
- File-scope mismatch produces failed or needs_human; cannot produce passed silently.
- Attempt/epoch/revision mismatch produces a stale-report error, not acceptance.
- Generic task.set cannot replace report.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Unit tests: baseline capture, stale report rejection, file-scope mismatch verdict changes.
- Focused verification tests with dirty worktree preconditions.

nodes.title: Append-only immutable verification with invalidation
nodes.description:
Verification reports become content-addressed and append-only. Invalidating a report for acceptance purposes retains it for historical display. General task patches cannot write, replace, or delete reports, lifecycle, or review fields.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Identical report content produces the same contentId and is persisted idempotently.
- A later revision or re-verification appends; it does not overwrite the existing report.
- Invalidation sets invalidatedAt and reason; it does not delete the report.
- updateTask's applyTaskPatch refuses immutable fields on orchestrated boards.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Unit tests: content idempotency, invalidation, patch rejection.

nodes.title: File-scope verdict integration and child verification completeness
nodes.description:
File-scope mismatch affects the verdict. Missing/unknown child IDs, stale child reports, and incomplete child verification make composite verification incomplete rather than passing.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- fileScope.scopeMatches === false → verdict is failed or needs_human according to policy.
- Unresolved child IDs produce incomplete verdict.
- Stale child reports (revision mismatch) produce incomplete verdict.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Unit tests for each verdict-affecting condition.

nodes.title: Atomic decomposition approval and stale assessment refresh
nodes.description:
Approval, child creation, criteria/files, internal dependencies, rewiring, cycle validation, parent composite state, and proposal applied status commit atomically. Refresh atomicity assessment when its config hash no longer matches the board policy.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- DecompositionApprove is all-or-nothing in one board mutation.
- A fault before commit leaves original proposed state untouched.
- Repeating the same approval idempotently returns the already-applied result.
- Validates dependsOnIndex, self-dependency, missing child, cycles.
- Orchestrated children begin in Backlog with lifecycle initialized.
- atomicityAssessment with stale configHash is refreshed before readiness can reject it.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Fault injection at every decomposition approval step.
- Stale assessment refresh tests.

nodes.title: Independent P2 verification and decomposition acceptance gate
nodes.description:
Verifies attempt-bound baselines, immutable/verdict-correct reports, and atomic decomposition.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Attempt-bound report baselines are captured and compared.
- File-scope mismatch fails acceptance.
- Generic update_task cannot mutate reports, lifecycle, or reviews on orchestrated boards.
- Decomposition approval is atomic under injected faults.
- Independent review reports no Critical/High finding.

**Verification:**
- P2 conformance fixtures pass.
- Fault injection log and reviewer report attached.

nodes.title: Unify dependency semantics across engines
nodes.description:
Ensure Kanban, TaskTracker, TaskDAG, SDD scheduler, SDD legacy helpers, session projection, and task-graph import/export use dependency→dependent direction and the same satisfaction policy. Mark/remove legacy helpers with opposite direction.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- All active engines: completed, skipped, waived satisfy; failed blocks unless continueOnFailure is explicit.
- Round-trips preserve direction and policy.
- Conformance tests run the same graph through every engine and assert identical readiness outcomes.
- Legacy opposite-direction helpers are fenced or removed.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Conformance graph fixture tests.

nodes.title: Continuous scheduler port over canonical commands
nodes.description:
Extract a neutral scheduler that operates over Kanban ReserveAttempt/StartAttempt/SubmitAttempt and uses dependency readiness, priority, WIP, capacity, boundaries, route, cost, and retry state.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Scheduler fills free slots immediately from dependency-ready work.
- Scheduling considers WIP, boundary policy, route availability, cost ceiling, retry timing.
- Pause stops new attempts; stop correctly releases/cancels in-flight attempts per policy.
- Retries, failed-task sweeps, deadlock recovery, no-progress cutoff, and wall-clock backstops.
- Restart resets or expires orphans without duplicate execution.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Continuous scheduling E2E tests with dependency DAGs and pause/resume/stop.

nodes.title: Worktree isolation and rollback evidence for scheduler attempts
nodes.description:
Wire optional worktree allocation, branch/commit/conflict tracking, and rollback evidence into the scheduler's attempt lifecycle.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Worktree identity is part of the attempt baseline.
- Successful attempts record merge commit; conflicted attempts record conflict files.
- Rollback reverts landed commits and releases worktrees.
- Worktree evidence is persisted on the attempt record.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Worktree scheduler scenario tests.

nodes.title: Kanban queue dispatch as scheduler adapter
nodes.description:
Refactor kanban_queue dispatch_ready to call the continuous scheduler port instead of its own claim-then-dispatch loop. Legacy Boarding stays available for non-scheduler use.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- kanban_queue dispatch_ready submits tasks to the scheduler.
- Existing dispatch configuration (cost, route, worktree) is preserved.
- Legacy claimReadyTask remains for non-scheduled (mirror/legacy) use.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Conformance dispatches produce identical state through scheduler and legacy paths.

nodes.title: Independent P3 scheduler convergence acceptance gate
nodes.description:
Verifies all active engines agree on dependency direction/policy, scheduler meets continuous execution requirements, and kanban_queue is an adapter.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Conformance dependency DAG produces identical readiness across Kanban, TaskTracker, TaskDAG, SDD, and scheduler.
- Scheduler pause/resume/stop/restart tests pass.
- Zero duplicate execution counts across restart scenarios.
- kanban_queue dispatch_ready works through scheduler.
- Independent review reports no Critical/High finding.

**Verification:**
- P3 conformance fixtures pass.
- Continuous scheduler E2E logs.
- Reviewer report attached.

nodes.title: Typed verification, review, and repair records in Kanban
nodes.description:
Define and persist VerificationRun, ReviewDecision, and RepairRequest records within Kanban data model. Add AcceptTask, RequestReview, DecideReview, RequestRepair commands.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- VerificationRun is typed, attempt-bound, and persists canonically.
- ReviewDecision references attempt+verification run IDs, not task snapshots.
- RepairRequest creates a new attempt while preserving rejected/previous evidence.
- RecordVerification and DecideReview commands are idempotent.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Unit tests for each typed record and command.

nodes.title: Director quality-gate adapter for typed Kanban protocol
nodes.description:
Adapt Director quality_gate output into Kanban VerificationRun and ReviewDecision. Ensure quality gate results are persisted and referenced correctly.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- quality_gate verdict pass/fail → Kanban ReviewDecision.
- quality_gate mustFix and uncertainty → Kanban repair request or review fields.
- quality_gate result references attemptId and verificationRunId.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- quality_gate->Kanban round-trip integration tests.

nodes.title: Reviewer independence enforcement
nodes.description:
Policy may require the reviewer identity to differ from the implementer identity. Enforce at DecideReview time.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- When board policy requires independent review, a reviewer who matches the worker identity is rejected.
- Worker identity comes from the attempt record, not task assignee.
- Policy is per-board or per-task.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Unit tests for independence gate.

nodes.title: RequestReview from submit to review transition
nodes.description:
When a worker submits a result, a separate RequestReview command transitions Running→Review on orchestrated boards. Worker success never produces Done directly.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- SubmitAttempt persists implementation result; task remains Running.
- RequestReview creates Review when evidence and attempt state are valid.
- Strict boards refuse direct completed assignment transitions.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Running → Review transition tests.

nodes.title: Independent P4 review/quality/repair acceptance gate
nodes.description:
Verifies typed review protocol, quality-gate adapter, reviewer independence, and the submit→review→accept path.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Worker submit → task stays Running; RequestReview → Review.
- DecideReview (pass) → AcceptTask → Done. DecideReview (changes_requested) → new attempt.
- quality_gate output persists as Kanban ReviewDecision.
- Reviewer independence enforced.
- Independent review reports no Critical/High finding.

**Verification:**
- P4 conformance fixtures pass.
- quality_gate→Kanban integration test.
- Reviewer report attached.

nodes.title: Explicit board profiles on creation and migration
nodes.description:
New boards are created with resolved profile (legacy, mirror, orchestrated). Existing boards without profile resolve as legacy. Profile is an audited, explicit field, not inferred.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- createBoard accepts profile field.
- Session boards create as mirror.
- Task-graph/source-imported boards create as mirror.
- Legacy adoption of managed lifecycle creates as orchestrated.
- Generic updateBoard cannot change profile.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Unit tests for profile resolution and creation.

nodes.title: Mirror board sync rules and source authority enforcement
nodes.description:
Mirror-owned source sync updates only owned fields. Source-owned status cannot bypass orchestrated Definition of Done. Manual follow-up tasks and dependencies survive sync.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Mirror sync updates only fields tagged as source-owned.
- Orchestrated lifecycle, attempt, review, and evidence are never overwritten by sync.
- Manual tasks and manual dependencies survive sync unless explicitly removed.
- Autonomous claim is disabled on mirror boards.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Sync scenarios: source-only fields, manual follow-up survival, ownership matrix tests.

nodes.title: Explicit promotion and demotion with validation
nodes.description:
Add explicit promotion from legacy/mirror to orchestrated and demotion from orchestrated to legacy/mirror. Demotion blocked while active attempts or unresolved reviews exist.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Promotion validates five lifecycle columns, task details, and writes audit metadata.
- Demotion is blocked when active attempts or reviews exist.
- Demotion is reversible without data loss.
- Both are audited commands.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Promotion/demotion tests.

nodes.title: Session projection and bidirectional idempotency
nodes.description:
Ensure bidirectional Kanban↔session projection is bounded, origin-idempotent, and does not oscillate. Session boards remain mirror by default.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Same snapshot does not produce a board write.
- Origin IDs remain stable.
- Reverse projection (board→session) does not overwrite non-session tasks.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Projection idempotency and oscillation tests.

nodes.title: Independent P5 projection authority acceptance gate
nodes.description:
Verifies explicit profiles, mirror sync rules, promotion/demotion, and session projection.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- New boards resolve correct profile.
- Mirror sync cannot overwrite orchestrated state.
- Promotion/demotion tests pass.
- Session projection is idempotent.
- Independent review reports no Critical/High finding.

**Verification:**
- P5 conformance fixtures pass.
- Reviewer report attached.

nodes.title: Command idempotency and transactional file-backed outbox
nodes.description:
Every canonical command is idempotent via command ID deduplication. Board mutation and outbox commitment happen atomically on the file backend. An outbox flusher appends JSONL events and marks delivered idempotently.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Same command ID + input returns original result.
- Same command ID + different input returns conflict.
- Board state + pending outbox entries commit in one file mutation.
- Crash after board commit but before event append is recovered.
- Event trimming never deletes undelivered entries or active-task-required evidence.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Fault injection: crash after board commit, before event append.
- Idempotency and conflict tests.

nodes.title: Schema migration and writer-version fence
nodes.description:
Implement explicit board schema upcasters, compatibility projections, future-version mutation fences, and non-destructive migration path.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Versionless/v1 boards readable but not rewritten on read.
- Unknown future versions fail closed for mutation.
- Migration creates a backup before irreversible transformation.
- Old writers cannot mutate board after newer writer-only feature is committed.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Mixed-version, corrupt-file, upgrade/downgrade, backup-restore tests.

nodes.title: Fenced controller lease and deterministic health/observability
nodes.description:
Supervisors compete for a fenced controller lease. Queue health accurately separates dependency-blocked from ready. Health exposes stage/attempt durations, review wait, recovery latency, retries, claim conflicts, and scheduler utilization. whyNotReady diagnostics.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- One controller owns scheduling per board.
- Two concurrent supervisors produce exactly one controller.
- Health counts do not double-count dependency-blocked in ready.
- whyNotReady returns deterministic reasons.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Supervisor lease contention tests.
- whyNotReady unit tests.

nodes.title: Per-board watcher and projection repair hardening
nodes.description:
Each board has a separate watcher debounce timer. Watcher retries registration when the kanban directory appears later. Projection repair reports anomaly when state is ambiguous.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Each board debounce is independent.
- Missing directory at start does not permanently disable watching.
- Repair reports blocked when authoritative state is ambiguous.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Watcher tests with delayed directory creation.
- Ambiguous state repair tests.

nodes.title: Governed advisory agent learning
nodes.description:
Completed outcomes may produce advisory routing/estimate/verifier/decomposition suggestions without changing policy autonomously.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Learning records are grounded with what/why/how evidence and reference task/attempt/report IDs.
- Suggestions are scoped by project, role, task type, board profile.
- Cost/retry/boundary/lifecycle/reviewer policy changes require explicit approval.
- Disabling learning has no effect on deterministic operations.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Learning record tests; disable/reenable tests.

nodes.title: Independent P6 reliability and observability acceptance gate
nodes.description:
Verifies idempotency, outbox crash recovery, schema migration, controller lease, health/whyNotReady, watcher hardening, and advisory learning.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Command dedupe and outbox crash recovery tests pass.
- Schema version fence and backup/restore tests pass.
- One supervisor owns each board.
- Health output matches canonical state.
- Learning is advisory-only.
- Independent review reports no Critical/High finding.

**Verification:**
- P6 conformance fixtures pass.
- Fault injection log.
- Reviewer report attached.

nodes.title: Storage port and SQLite schema
nodes.description:
Introduce KanbanStore port. Build SQLite schema for tasks, dependencies, attempts, lifecycle transitions, verification runs, review decisions, commands, and outbox. Import existing JSON boards without deleting originals.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Storage port preserves current manager/domain API behavior.
- SQLite schema covers all canonical types.
- Import idempotent; source JSON unchanged.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Import scenario tests.

nodes.title: Shadow-write parity and fault injection
nodes.description:
Shadow-write SQLite alongside JSON authority. Compare canonical projections after every mutation. Add fault injection: process crash, lock contention, partial disk write, duplicate command, stale schema, downgrade.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- No unexplained projection mismatches.
- Fault injection does not produce different state in JSON and SQLite.
- Parity metrics are logged.

**Verification:**
- Shadow parity test suite.
- Fault injection log.

nodes.title: SQLite read cutover, compatibility, and offline rollback
nodes.description:
Switch read authority to SQLite after parity gate passes. Retain JSON export and down-migration for at least one compatibility window. Define and test offline downgrade procedure.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Read cutover requires maintainer approval.
- Feature flag can immediately restore JSON reads.
- Export from SQLite to JSON is lossless.
- Offline downgrade from SQLite to JSON retains all committed commands.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Cutover/restore/export/downgrade tests.

nodes.title: Independent P7 transactional storage acceptance gate
nodes.description:
Verifies storage port preserves behavior, shadow parity has zero mismatches, cutover/rollback tests pass, and maintainer explicitly approves read cutover.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Storage port conformance fixtures pass.
- Shadow parity: zero unexplained mismatches.
- Fault injection produces identical recovery.
- Cutover, restore, and offline downgrade tests pass.
- Maintainer documented approval.

**Verification:**
- P7 gate test suite.
- Parity and fault logs.
- Maintainer approval attached.
